annotations.title: Publish a video to YouTube or X

description: Post a finished video to one of the user's connected accounts. Only call after the user explicitly agreed to publish and confirmed the title (YouTube) or post text (X): this posts publicly on their behalf. YouTube: posted right away, free, needs `title`; set `privacy` (default public). X: posted now or at `scheduled_at`, needs `text` (max 280 characters, links count as 23); costs credits charged only when the post goes out - tell the user the cost from get_publishing_status first. `video_url` must be a TTSForFree link: final_video_url from get_localization_status, or public_url of a video uploaded with create_upload_url.

account_id.description: account_id from get_publishing_status. Required when several accounts share a platform.

platform.description: Use when the user has exactly one account on that platform.

scheduled_at.description: X only: ISO 8601 time with offset, e.g. 2026-11-20T09:00:00+07:00. Omit to post now. Ask the user for their time zone if unclear.
